evidence.title: Bringing Nunchaku 4-bit Diffusion Inference to Diffusers

summary: Hugging Face has incorporated Nunchaku's 4-bit diffusion inference into its Diffusers library, enabling more efficient AI image generation. The update aims to reduce computational costs while maintaining model performance.
title: Nunchaku 4-bit Diffusion Inference Integrated into Hugging Face Diffusers
